scope: Seven active storyboard crops only; measured source inventory and static visual comparison, no generation or edit changes.

shots.purpose: A warm door in the winter night; establish the destination.
The lit entrance draws closer.
Another winter night outside.
Return to winter; no fantasy recovery.

small_sources.match_assessment: No same-scene high-resolution match found. B03 is a different courtyard at dawn, without the frontal lit entrance; changing its colour would not restore this scene.
small_sources.recommendation: Retain composition as the brief for a future high-resolution source. Keep one consistent entrance shared with journey/arrival; do not regenerate four separate plates.

shots.purpose: A quiet portrait before the first verse.
Her composure is inward and unsettled, not reassuring.

small_sources.match_assessment: A02 preserves approved identity, clothes and hospital withdrawal, but she is seated at the window in a portrait frame, not standing in this doorway. S01/S02 include him and would prematurely establish his presence.
small_sources.recommendation: If the two shots only need the inward portrait described in edit.json, an explicit restaging to A02 is possible; it is not an exact replacement. Prefer revising/reusing one reviewed portrait over inventing another face, while checking repetition and 16:9 crop detail.

shots.purpose: His journey through the snow; a storyboard pose, not a false walk cycle.

small_sources.match_assessment: No matching high-resolution rear-view walk toward the snowy entrance. Character/angle sheets are isolated pose references, not walking/contact footage or this background.
small_sources.recommendation: Preserve this specific travel action when a new keyframe is needed; a portrait, camera move or standing cutout cannot replace a believable walk. Reuse the same entrance design as night_hospital.

shots.purpose: He arrives afraid, not certain of a cure.

small_sources.match_assessment: No matching high-resolution door-handle/arrival plate. Existing S01/S02/M01 show him already seated beside her; cropping him from those images changes the action and chronology.
small_sources.recommendation: Keep as a separate source gap. Use A01 for identity and existing hospital/performance art for light facial hair/clothes; do not replace frightened arrival with an unrelated seated reaction.

shots.purpose: Her lowered gaze establishes the emotional centre.
The calm becomes worrying in a sustained reaction.
Her response remains withdrawn.
The weight of her words; hold her inward gaze.
A quiet held response before memory opens.
A restrained response rather than instant recovery.
A close inward portrait in near silence.
Scream two lands against her stillness; no comfort reversal.

small_sources.match_assessment: Existing refined candidate is the same scene/acting intent and a source-reviewed compatible redraw, not the same pixels or a mathematically exact upscale. A02 is the approved identity source, but a different frontal portrait composition.
small_sources.recommendation: Reuse the existing refined candidate as the first candidate for these uses; no new artwork needed for the source test. Recheck each crop, reflection and post-embrace context before edit promotion. Do not mechanically copy the existing 1.075 zoom into its already tight crown crop.

shots.purpose: An empty corridor makes the night feel long.
Time and distance in the hospital.
The night continues past the repeated hook.
The corridor narrows toward the quiet bridge.

small_sources.match_assessment: B01 is a compatible high-resolution empty hospital waiting-room angle: same blue chairs, left windows and warm doorway. It lacks the deep axial corridor/vanishing point, so it is a scene-angle substitution.
small_sources.recommendation: Reuse B01 for an explicitly revised empty-hospital pause where corridor travel/distance is not essential, especially S005 before arrival. Later empty views must not imply the couple vanished. Preserve the corridor as a source gap if its axial composition is retained.

shots.purpose: A wider morning breath after the final hook.
They remain together without a triumphant gesture.
End on ongoing company. Fade only during the final two seconds.

small_sources.match_assessment: S06 has the same pair, present clothes, unresolved exhaustion and dawn, but they remain INSIDE. B03 is OUTSIDE but empty and differently composed. Neither is the two-person exterior bench.
small_sources.recommendation: Do not silently swap in S06 after the established exterior transition; that would reintroduce an indoor/outdoor jump. Either retain the outdoor-bench source gap or explicitly revise the ending to stay indoors. The ending remains a proposal, not approved recovery.

pixel_exact_crop_comparison: All seven crops match the extraction rectangles pixel-for-pixel in the original 1672×941 nine-panel board; no hidden high-resolution individual panels.
limits: Static source audit only; no motion approval or user creative sign-off.
Optional v1 release artwork is not restored locally; source-map inventory inspected only, not unseen image pixels. No provider download was requested.
Branch comparison covers fetched pinned tips, not every historical deleted image or inaccessible private chat.
